name: CacheGetSoundId
comment: Name (or handle) -> sound slot id (100..131) of the 32-slot sound cache. A name that is not cached is LOADED here (a free slot, or Sounds_EvictOldestIdleSlot). A handle (0x457..0x556, the number Lua gets from ImStartSound; one per cached SOUND, not per playing instance, reused when the slot is) that is not in the cache gives 0. Returns 0 when it cannot load. Callers: SoundsGetParam returns 1 (!) for 0, so ImGetParam(name or stale handle, anything) reads 1, i.e. 'playing', when the sound is not resolvable (sound_playing loops).
